question: Describe a time you optimized application performance.
intendedUser: Professional in Track-A with mid-career experience
description: Behavioural interview question for Track-A professionals.
exampleAnswer: Our dashboard loaded in 8 seconds. Situation: users were frustrated. I profiled the app and found 3 bottlenecks: unoptimized images, N+1 database queries, and no caching. I implemented lazy loading, eager loading, and Redis caching. Result: load time reduced to 2 seconds, and user satisfaction improved by 40% (measured via survey).
weakAnswerPitfalls: Vague or generic response without specific examples
Focusing on process without mentioning personal contribution
Failing to connect to the target role
evaluationCriteria: Clarity, performance, specific examples, measurable outcomes
followUpQuestions: How does this apply to the Track-A role?
Can you provide more specific examples?
